{{Recipe}}

'''Marly sponge''' is a [[Cookbook:Meringue|meringue]] stabilized with flour. It is typically used as a component in other pastries.

== Ingredients ==

* 5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (150 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Almond Flour|almond meal]]
* 2¼ oz (70 g) cake [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 8 oz (250 g) superfine [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 8 oz (250 g) [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 5 oz (150 g) superfine sugar

== Preparation ==

# Mix the almonds, flour, and the first quantity of sugar with a wire [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]].
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites to soft peaks.
# Add the second quantity of sugar, little by little, and beat to firm peaks.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the almond mixture into the egg whites.
# Line a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]] with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]] and draw circles of the required diameter on the paper.
# Using a [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|pastry bag]], [[Cookbook:Piping|pipe]] spirals of meringue into the circles.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F (180°C) for 12–15 minutes.
